test_title: SSC Stenographer 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 11 Dec, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question:
Select the option that expresses the given sentence in active voice.

He must be written to by us.

options.text: I have been writing to him.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Passive voice structure: The object of the active voice sentence becomes the subject of the passive voice sentence.
 
• In the active voice, the sentence is: "We must write to him."
 
• To convert to passive voice: Place the object "him" at the beginning.
 
• Change the active verb form "must write" to "must be written" (modal passive).
 
• Add the preposition "by" followed by the original subject "us."

Therefore, the correct answer is **Option 3**.

 

**Correct Sentence:** *"We must write to him."*

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Option 1: **"We can write." – This is not a complete sentence and does not convey the same meaning.
 
• **Option 2: **"I have been writing to him." – Incorrect tense and subject.
 
• **Option 4: **"We are writing to him." – Incorrect tense.
